_meta.semantics: inclusive time filter on the context/spec range; BP->CE via present_ce - age_bp; splice keeps paleo rows strictly before splice_year_ce and instrumental rows from it onward (prefer_instrumental); rebaseline shifts the manifest apply_to member by minus its own mean over alignment_period_ce before splicing; rolling_mean is a centred window [year - (w-1)/2, year + (w-1)/2] emitting only complete windows (exactly int(w) members, matching charts/transforms.py); unit_conversion multiplies by the code-owned factor. Tolerances: 1e-9 relative pass-through, 1e-6 relative post-transform (DESIGN section 6.2).
